what: Hovering one menu item blurs the other items by 5px (.5s power2.out) and blurs the background photo behind the screen by 13px (.5s power1.out) — only the chosen word looks crisp. On leave, items return to rest blur in .5s and the background in .4s (0 on the first page, 13 stays on sub pages). Attached to a single logo with no menu cell, hovering blurs the area behind the screen curtain by 15px (backdrop-filter 1.5s power3.out, .9s on leave)

options.[data-fx-part=item]: Menu slot — if missing, hovering the element itself blurs only the target
options.target: CSS selector for what blurs along with it (like the background photo .bg) — if none, only the menus blur
options.blur: Blur of remaining menu items (px), default 5
options.rest: Blur (px) of the target when released, default 0 — use 13 for an always-blurred background like subpages
options.prop: If “backdrop,” the target’s backdrop-filter (screen veil), otherwise filter by default
options.target-in: Fade-out length of the target (sec), default .5 — logo curtain 1.5
options.target-out: Return duration for the target (sec), default .4 — logo curtain .9
options.target-ease: Target curve, default power1.out — logo curtain power3.out
